dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Nuair a bhíonn tú thart leis an obair, cad déanaim tú?
dialogue.translation: When you're finished with work, what do you do?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Déanaim siopadóireacht nó léim leabhair.
dialogue.translation: I go shopping or read a book.

key_phrases.phrase: Cad déanaim fút gach maidin?
key_phrases.translation: What do I do every morning?

key_phrases.translation: I go to my work at eight.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Cé ar bith is maith leat, mé?
dialogue.translation: What would you like, me?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Tá an mór-ghorta is maith ar an me Núñez, ach nílim cinnte.
dialogue.translation: The big dish is good on the menu, but I'm not sure.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Cé gur maith liom an spagetti, is fearr liom an pizza mar tá sí níos fearr le mé.
dialogue.translation: Although I like the spaghetti, I prefer the pizza as it is better with me.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ceapaim go bhfuil tú ceart, is dócha go bhfuil an pizza níos fearr.
dialogue.translation: I think you're right, the pizza is probably better.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Conas atá tú? Bain mo airgead as an gcuntar, más é do thoil é.
dialogue.translation: How are you? Take my money from the account, please.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ar dhóigh maith, go raibh maith agat. Féach ar an gcuntas, an bhfuil sé ceart?
dialogue.translation: Fine, thank you. Look at the account, is it right?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Tá, dhéanaim i láthair na huaire. Sin é.
dialogue.translation: Yes, I do it right now. That's it.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Go maith. An bhfuil aon rud eile i do chuntas?
dialogue.translation: Good. Is there anything else in your account?
